description: The Voyager record cover rebuilt as an exact layered SVG in millimetres (304.8 mm disc), traced from the 1977 NASA photo; binary digits and map geometry from data/cover.json.
inputs: sources/pioneer-svg/Pioneer_plaque.svg (digit positions along the pulsar lines only, via tools/data/svgmap.py)

settings.scaleNote: 12 inch disc, the diameter of the record it protects; pixels per mm from a circle fit to the photo edge (tools/cover/measure.py measure_disc)
settings.etchFilter: top-hat (9 px opening, sigma 5 background) normalised by local etch brightness (tools/cover/etch.py)
settings.binaryRows: components of the thresholded etch, thresholds stepped until the row reads as data/cover.json; marks never edited
handMeasured: plan-view cartridge outline and side-view cartridge (read from 6x and 8x crops)
waveform vertices after the 8-peak burst (read from 5x and 6x crops; automatic tracers cut the sharp dips)
photo-pixel coordinates are stored in assets-src/cover/geometry.json with provenance strings
settings.mapPlacement: similarity from two measured points, the Sun and the end tick of the centre line (tools/cover/placement.py)

python: 3.14 (numpy, scipy, scikit-image, opencv, networkx, Pillow); node: sharp for the overlay only
